summary: Verified the latest iteration's new features end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_calendar_and_journal_crud.py — 10/10 pytest passed covering (a) GET /api/calendar shape, 90 trading days, weekday<5 (Sat/Sun excluded), 18 weeks with required keys; (b) journal POST returns id, appears in GET /api/journal; (c) calendar tradeCount/wins/losses aggregate after a new journal entry on the same date; (d) PUT /api/journal/{id} persists market/notes/rEarned/result changes; (e) DELETE /api/journal/{id} returns {deleted:1} and removes from list; (f) deleting unknown id returns {deleted:0}. Frontend: bypassed Google OAuth by seeding a Mongo session row and injecting freezy_session_token in localStorage. Verified on mobile viewport 390x844: dashboard shows open-profile-btn → /settings shows ACCOUNT card with seeded email (test_user@example.com) + Sign Out button (testID=logout-btn). Planner tab renders 18 week-cards (testID=week-card-N) with 18 week-toggles; Week 1 auto-expanded shows 5 day-cells with real calendar dates MON JUN 22, TUE JUN 23, WED JUN 24, THU JUN 25, FRI JUN 26 (weekends skipped). Journal '+' opens modal in 'LOG TRADE / New Entry' mode; saving creates an entry. Tapping the entry (testID=journal-entry-<id>) reopens the modal in 'EDIT TRADE / Update Entry' mode with prefilled fields (verified market='EURUSD_UI', rEarned='2.5'). Updating R Earned saves successfully. Tapping the entry again then delete-trade → confirm-delete-trade removes it from the list. No red-screen errors. Existing non-blocking web warnings persist: props.pointerEvents deprecated, shadow* style props deprecated (carried over from iteration 1, not introduced by this iteration).

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — migrate to boxShadow with Platform.select. Already reported in iteration_1.

Web console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Already reported in iteration_1; e.g. /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:39,45 still uses pointerEvents as a prop on <LinearGradient>.

action_items: Optional polish: replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on the two LinearGradient nodes in login.tsx and any other places.
Optional polish: replace shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius with boxShadow via Platform.select to silence the web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/calendar correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection on plan + journal queries.

Calendar enrichment indexes journal by ISO date (date-only key), so trades made today on a weekday correctly aggregate into the matching plan day; weekend-created entries won't surface (acceptable — plan only has Mon-Fri).

ensure_plan auto-rebuilds legacy plans whose day 1 lands on a weekend by detecting weekday>=5 on day 1 and wiping plan_days — could destroy user notes/checklist if they ever opened the app under an older build, but only triggers once.
PUT /api/journal/{id} does not 404 when entry_id is unknown; it just returns null. Minor — consider raising 404 for clarity.
DELETE /api/journal/{id} always returns 200 (with deleted:0 when nothing matched) — matches the contract used by the frontend.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (profile→settings, planner weeks/days, journal create/edit/delete)

seed_data_creation: Created a fake user (test_user@example.com) + valid session token in Mongo via /tmp/seed_session.py so the React app could be driven without going through Emergent Google OAuth. Token used: test-session-9407631c033d4d3c811eab43aac985bf. Backend tests prefix data with TEST_ and self-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To drive the OAuth-gated UI without real Google login: (1) run /tmp/seed_session.py to insert a user + user_sessions row into Mongo and obtain a token; (2) in Playwright, visit /login, then await page.evaluate(`window.localStorage.setItem('freezy_session_token', '<token>')`); (3) navigate to /. The AuthProvider reads localStorage on cold start, calls /api/auth/me with the bearer token, and unlocks (tabs). Critical testIDs added in this iteration: open-profile-btn (dashboard), logout-btn (settings), week-card-N / week-toggle-N (planner), day-cell-N (planner), journal-entry-<id> (journal list), delete-trade + confirm-delete-trade (journal edit modal), save-trade, trade-market, trade-r-earned. Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_freezy_api.py (full suite) + /app/backend/tests/test_calendar_and_journal_crud.py (new features).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
